label: IC speed test: N=45 baseline vs N=64 candidate, 20-bit prime field
description: Frozen before the run. One session on the latest main ecbench: the 20-bit prime-field IC baseline (prime-abscissa:size=45) against the candidate factor base (size=64), both with mitm:negation_folded=1, plus a matched rho reference and an A/A control. Public synthetic curve; no security claim. Decision rule in research/ic_profile_20261029/README.md: N=64 replaces N=45 only if the 95% upper bound of the paired S ratio is below 1 at every weight in the §5a band.
